# LJ Create

> > Educational training equipment and lab solutions for electronics, automotive technology, PLC programming, and STEM education.

LJ Create is an ISO 9001:2015 certified manufacturer based in Orlando, FL and Norwich, UK, specializing in hands-on training systems for technical education. Their product line includes electronics study trainers, PLC trainers, automotive diagnostic equipment, and engineering construction kits for students and professionals.

## Key Topics

- Electronics Study Trainer (320-00 series)
- PLC Programming & Industrial Control
- Automotive Technology & Diagnostics
- STEM Education & Robotics
- Motor Control Systems
- Digital Logic & Sequential Circuits
- Mechatronics & Automation
- Electric Vehicle Systems
- Allen Bradley PLC
- CAN Bus Technology
- ISO 9001:2015 Quality Standards
- ETA Certification Training
- Flip-flops & Binary Counters
- Filter Circuits & Active Electronics
- Engineering Construction Kits

## Electronics & Circuit Training

- [Electrical/Electronic Engineering Lab](https://ljcreate.com/engineering/complete-lab-solutions/electronic-engineering): Complete lab solutions for ETA certification and electronics training
- [Sequential Logic Card](https://ljcreate.com/es/engineering/sequential-logic-card): Sequential logic card (320-42) for Electronics Study Trainer
- [Diodes and Transistors Card](https://ljcreate.com/es/engineering/diodes-and-transistors-card): Diodes and transistors card (320-21) for Electronics Study Trainer
- [Filter Circuits Study Module](https://ljcreate.com/es/engineering/filter-circuits-study-module): Filter circuits study module (303-32) for active/passive filter learning
- [Electronic Circuits Student Resource Pack](https://ljcreate.com/es/engineering/electronic-circuits-student-resource-pack): Electronic circuits student resource pack (450-02) with breadboard components
- [PIC Programmer and Applications Card](https://ljcreate.com/engineering/pic-programmer-and-applications-card): PIC programmer card (320-61) for microcontroller programming and motor control

## PLC & Industrial Automation

- [Mobile PLC Trainer Teaching Set (Allen Bradley)](https://ljcreate.com/uk/engineering/mobile-plc-trainer-teaching-set-allen-bradley): Mobile Allen Bradley PLC trainer (291-04/AB) in waterproof case
- [Engineering Training Resources](https://ljcreate.com/es/ingenieria/recursos-de-formacion): Engineering training resources covering PLC, motor control, and mechatronics
- [Power Supply Unit](https://ljcreate.com/es/engineering/power-supply-unit): Power supply unit (207-40) for motor control and electrical training

## Automotive Technology

- [Anti-Lock Braking Systems Panel Trainer](https://ljcreate.com/automotive-technology/anti-lock-braking-systems-panel-trainer): ABS panel trainer (755-01) for brake system fault-finding and diagnostics

## STEM & Engineering Kits

- [Engineering Construction Kit](https://ljcreate.com/es/ingenieria/kit-de-construccion-de-ingenieria): Engineering construction kit (220-02) for robotics and automation projects
